description: Java class defining a validator for RabbitMQ connection protocol, including scheme validation, source and target configuration validation, and connection type specification.

classes.name: RabbitMQValidator
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractProtocolValidator, providing validation logic for RabbitMQ connection protocols, including scheme validation and configuration checks.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of RabbitMQValidator.

methods.name: validateSource
methods.description: Validates the source configuration, including enforcement templates and header mappings.

methods.name: validateTarget
methods.description: Validates the target configuration, including header mappings and address templates.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the connection type, specifically ConnectionType.AMQP_091.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs comprehensive validation of the connection, including URI scheme, source and target configs, and payload mappings.
